product_metadata.title: KESOL Sturdy 304 Stainless Steel Utensil Drying Rack Basket Holder with Hooks 3 Divided Compartments, Rust Proof, No Drilling
features: 3 divided compartments to separate and organize your kitchen utensils. Tighter bottom mesh prevent silverware fall.
Hooks design attaches easily to most wired dish drainer. SUS 304 Stainless steel material, waterproof and rust proof.
Open design allows water to drain down quickly. If any rust occurs in the product within 5 years, we will send you a replacement free, no return required.
CONVENIENCE- Stainless steel drying basket holds small utensils, such as spoons, forks and knives where you need them. Keep countertops clear, no more mess around the sink.
DIMENSION: 7.9 inch x 1.8 inch x 4.5inch. We provide Quality Service by 5 years. When you have any quality issue, please contact us.
description: Need to replace your existing plastic silverware cup?
Need to find a Stainless Steel construction small silverware cup?

This small hooked utensil drying basket can attach easily to your existing wired dish drainer. Additional 3 compartments design can make you easily to organize small utensils, such as spoons, forks and knives.

Every Utensil Rack is made of SUS304 stainless steel which will not rust. There are cheaper options but which made of chrome or other steels that will rust within a few weeks. We provide Quality Service by 5 years. When you have any quality issue, please contact us.If any rust occurs in the product within 5 years, we will send you a replacement free, no return required. Note: SUS304 Stainless steel is the most widely used for food equipment, general equipment and atomic energy industry equipment. 304 Stainless steel has better corrosion resistance and more expensive than other Stainless Steel.
